QuestInfo.name: [MONAD] The Fourth Act 3 Countdown Event!
QuestInfo.0: The Eyeful and the people of Abrup are anxiously awaiting your return to MONAD: The First Omen Act 3. They need a hero. Hold the Heart of the Eyeful and the Hope of Abrup's People for 30 minutes, and your connection will become stronger than ever, earning you an Earnest Heart!
